items.q: How does circular GPU financing work?
items.a: Nvidia **invests in a neocloud**, which uses the money to **buy Nvidia GPUs** and borrows the rest against them.
When chips **rent for less than they depreciate** or **lenders stop lending**.
Paying about **15% interest** on **$52B** of debt.
